# Teridox

> Teridox is a web development and software agency in Indonesia, founded in 2024. We build websites and web applications, cross-platform mobile apps (iOS and Android), SaaS products, and AI integrations for growing businesses.

## Services
- Web Development: custom websites and web apps built with React and Next.js for speed, SEO, and security.
- Mobile App Development: cross-platform apps with React Native and Flutter from a single codebase.
- SaaS Solutions: database design, authentication, payment integration, and multi-tenant logic (Node.js, PostgreSQL).
- AI Integration: automation and AI features added to existing workflows and applications.

## Pricing and timelines
Pricing and timelines depend on scope. Send a short brief through the contact form and Teridox replies with a quote.

Use the [contact form](https://teridox.com/contact). It accepts `name`, `email`, `subject`, and `message`.
